research_problem: SUBSTITUTE DOCUMENT (not the selected Ponce et al. 2025 IST SLR): Ghani et al. 2019 IJIE review of how microservice testing approaches address seven quality concerns (security, performance, traceability, compatibility, complexity, effectiveness, scalability)
technical_approach: SLR claiming Petersen guidelines; 7 databases + Google Scholar; 465 -> 173 -> 49 -> 15 primary studies (2013-2018); checkmark/x coding of parameters and study-quality questions
primary_contribution: Parameter-coverage and study-quality matrices for 15 microservice testing studies; description of unit/component/integration/contract/E2E test levels
evaluation_metrics: Descriptive counts and percentages; no quality-assessment score or inter-rater agreement
key_findings: Security addressed by 7/15, performance 9/15, complexity 10/15; unit testing ~75%, integration 10%, component/contract/E2E 5% each; only 1/15 compares with prior work; challenges include growing number of APIs, upgrade/maintenance and tester-consumer gap
author_limitations: Possible selection and analysis bias; gray literature may be missed; more studies and databases needed; interoperability, auditability, integrity, inconsistency not covered
analyst_limitations: IDENTITY MISMATCH with selected paper; inconsistent inclusion period (2010-2018 vs 2013-2018); online date precedes acceptance date; undefined parameters; no quality checklist or second reviewer; percentages over 15 studies; unsupported causal explanations; little API-specific testing coverage
reproducibility: Low: incomplete search and selection details; no extraction data released
suggested_extensions: Updated API-centric microservice testing mapping (post-2019 REST fuzzers, contract testing, observability oracles); consumer-driven contract synthesis for breaking-change detection; system-level multi-service REST testing benchmark
evidence_location: Identity p.1; RQs p.2; selection p.3-4; results p.8-12; threats/conclusion p.14
integrity: IDENTITY MISMATCH: PDF is Ghani et al. 2019 (10.30880/ijie.2019.11.08.008), not selected Ponce et al. 2025 (10.1016/j.infsof.2025.107870); tables 2-8 column-split; figures missing; duplicate reference blocks
